subject: scale_y_log10 can't control limit and breaks

messages.author: 51af56f8dba6ef19
messages.subject: scale_y_log10 can't control limit and breaks
parts:
Hello,

I would like to have more control of the limits and breaks of scale_y_log10 but can't, I basically need to have more y break values than 10^1 10^2 etc and it omits the breaks for the highest value and that's why I would like to modify the limits but then it fails with error "Error: Zero breaks in scale for y/ymin/ymax/yend/yintercept/ymin_final/ymax_final"

My snippet looks like this:

p <- ggplot(data=df, aes(x=n, y=rt, group=baseline, shape=baseline, colour=baseline)) + geom_point(fill="white", size=3) + geom_line() + xlab("n") + ylab("Log Runtime (s)") + opts(title=title,plot.title=theme_text(size=font.size)) +
 scale_y_log10(breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)))

Many TIA,
Best regards,
Giovanni
